story.title: Iraola awaits first win as Liverpool rescue late draw against Forest
story.summary: Liverpool come from behind twice to rescue a 2-2 draw against Nottingham Forest at Anfield, leaving new manager Andoni Iraola in search of his first Premier League win with the club.
